prompts.south: Use case: illustration-story. Isolated character cutout asset, not a poster. One full-body SOUTH-facing idle view of Rami, portrait 2:3, on a truly transparent RGBA canvas. There must be absolutely no background pixels: no black fill, no checkerboard, no gradient, no glow, no vignette, no halo, no ambient light, no cast shadow, no floor or ground plane. The area outside the character must have alpha=0 cleanly. Reference role: original supplied cast art, Rami specifically lower-left. Preserve his exact loose shoulder-length dark wavy hair (no braid or headband), warm brown skin, green and earth hiking cloak with cream hood/scarf and pale fern motifs, brown trousers, sturdy hiking boots, belt map scroll, satchel strap and fern details. No added jewelry or medals. Modern 2D matte painterly finish consistent with original. Calm neutral frontal pose, centered, generous empty transparent margins, both entire feet visible, equal optical scale. Orthographic straight-on; no scenery, text, frame, props beyond canonical outfit, no multiple characters, no collage or sprite sheet.
prompts.north: Use case: illustration-story. Make one separate full-body NORTH-facing REAR idle character cutout of Rami, portrait 2:3, transparent RGBA. References: first image is the selected SOUTH view and controls identity/outfit; second is the original cast image and controls source style and specific identity (Rami is lower-left). Keep exact loose shoulder-length dark wavy hair, warm brown skin, green/earth hiking cloak with cream hood/scarf and pale fern motifs, brown trousers, hiking boots, belt map scroll, satchel and fern details. No braid, no headband, no jewelry/medals. Straight back view facing away, relaxed arms, feet fully visible aligned to shared baseline, centered with margins. Show plausible back of garments and natural strap/map placement. Match modern 2D matte painterly source style. Clean isolated character on transparent canvas, no scene, ground, vignette, halo, glow, shadow, text or frame. One character only, no sheet/collage.
